modos.descricao: Armadura: reduz dano de 1 ataque em ate 4

params.descricao: Flak Jacket: stop any one attack of up to 4 damage (one-shot, descartada apos uso)

_metadata.texto_original: Armor. The Flak Jacket stops any one attack of up to 4 damage.  The owner chooses when the Flak Jacket is used.  Discard the Flak Jacket if it is used or if the owner changes to Crinos form.  A character cannot have more than 1 Flak Jacket at a time.
